newsitem.title: USA: KCS Energy acquires Gulf Coast reserves.
newsitem.headline: KCS Energy acquires Gulf Coast reserves.

text.p: KCS Energy Inc said it agreed to acquire 8.5 billion cubic feet equivalent (Bcfe) of proved oil and natural gas reserves from ATP Oil & Gas Corp.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
The reserves are from wells located on five of ATP's properties located in the onshore and offshore Gulf Coast area and consist of 7.4 Bcf of natural gas and 188,000 barrels of crude oil, KCS said.
About 95 percent of the crude oil is expected to be delivered by year-end 1998, the company said.
